I've got an honest question, and I'll try my best to be respectful in my tone.

The mission of this subverse is "A subverse to allow Admins, Mods and Users to discuss Voat while Being Transparent and Polite". What function does this sub provide that is not already covered by /v/ideasforvoat, which is monitored by the Admins, /v/askvoat, which is good for posing discussion questions to the community, and other special purpose subverses like /v/subverserequest and /v/voat?

My fear is that without any actual involvement from the Admins, this sub runs the risk of becoming a place where more influential mods can attempt to make administration changes site-wide. In reference to this post regarding possible vote manipulation why wouldn't such a thing be reported directly to Voat's administration? Instead it was reported to this sub and then reported to the admin. I don't see the need for a middleman in this situation and I'm worried that such an arrangement could evolve into a case of nobles trying to run the kingdom without working with the king. There was a lot of administration trouble on Reddit, but there was also problems with mods of large subreddits working together in negative ways to run the site by proxy. An example of this would be if a user does something to be banned on one sub and ends up banned on a dozen other large subs because of common moderators or closed door arrangements. Voat has safeguards to prevent such consolidation of moderating power, such as the ten subverse mod limit. But an insiders club of mods acting as admin could undermine these safeguards.

Lastly, I want to say that I don't question your right to exist as a sub, and I have to give you the benefit of the doubt that you have good intentions. My worries are based on what potentially might happen and not what I've seen happen here. I want you to know that I mean no disrespect here and bear no ill will. I'm just voicing my thoughts for consideration and in case others might share similar sentiment. Thank you for your time and have a good afternoon!
